description: This file defines the CellValue class used for creating and manipulating conditional formatting rules based on cell values within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to specify comparison operations, operands, and to generate Conditional objects for applying stylings based on cell content.

classes.name: CellValue
classes.description: A class for building conditional formatting rules based on the values of cells, with support for various comparison operations and parsing from existing conditional rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new CellValue object with a specified cell range.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the comparison operator, validating it against allowed operators.

methods.name: operand
methods.description: Sets an operand (value) at a specified index with optional value type.

methods.name: wrapValue
methods.description: Formats the operand value for use in conditional expressions, handling data types and string escaping.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Builds and returns a Conditional object based on current operator and operands.

methods.name: unwrapString
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string condition, handling escaped quotes.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a CellValue wizard from an existing Conditional object, parsing its conditions and settings.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for comparison operations, e.g., equals(), notEquals(), etc., and 'and' for range conditions.
